packageRules.description: Majors are never merged unattended, whatever kind of dependency they are. Two have landed on main unreviewed under the devDependencies rule above: TypeScript 7, which needed the build fixing before anything compiled, and changesets v2, which renamed every input the release job passes and so stopped releases outright. Both were found after the fact.

The vitest group moves together or not at all, and Storybook decides when. Storybook peer-requires vite-plus ^0.1.15 || ^0.2.0 — true of 10.5.10 and of the 10.6 betas — and vite-plus 0.2.9 in turn requires exactly @vitest/browser-playwright 4.1.10, which pins vitest to 4.1.10. So vite-plus 0.3 and vitest 4.1.11 cannot be taken until Storybook widens that range. These are pinned to exact versions rather than ranges so the constraint is visible in the manifest, and grouped here so Renovate offers them as one PR that either resolves or does not, instead of four that each half-break the install.
